<thought>To determine the number of C=O groups, the most direct and inexpensive method is to obtain the IR spectrum, which shows characteristic carbonyl stretching bands around 1650‑1800 cm⁻¹. By counting distinct carbonyl peaks in the IR data, we can infer the number of C=O groups present in the molecule.</thought>
